# SOP-P3-L4-03 First-article inspection - Heat Treat line

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P3, line P3-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L4-RR01, EQ-P3-L4-HT02, EQ-P3-L4-SB03

Preconditions
1. Parts produced for first-article inspection are identified and released by production.
2. Machines are in normal ready state and cleared of loose tooling and scrap.
3. Maintenance actions affecting dimensional condition have been completed and closed per MM-P3-L4-HT02 and MM-P3-L4-SB03-S2.
4. Calibration status of inspection instruments verified per SOP-P3-L4-01.

PPE
1. Safety glasses, cut-resistant gloves, and steel-toe footwear.
2. Hearing protection where posted.
3. Additional PPE as required by local permit.

Critical machine settings and consumables (do not alter without authorization)
- The mandrel clamp bolt torque for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P3-L4-RR01) is 605 N·m.
- The lubricant part number for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P3-L4-RR01) is CFW-LUB-315.

Procedure
1. Verify part identity against the first-article authorization and control plan.
2. Visually inspect incoming part for obvious defects; document observations on the FAI checklist.
3. Setup inspection fixtures and instruments; confirm instruments are within calibration per SOP-P3-L4-01.
4. Install part on EQ-P3-L4-RR01 using handling aids; confirm the mandrel clamp bolt torque per the critical machine settings above.
5. Perform dimensional checks per the FAI checklist. Record all measured values and note any deviations.
6. For any dimensions affected by heat-treat or straightening on EQ-P3-L4-HT02 and EQ-P3-L4-SB03, verify process records and reference MM-P3-L4-HT02 and MM-P3-L4-SB03-S2.
7. If findings are within acceptance, tag first-article as accepted and release to production; if nonconforming, tag and quarantine per containment procedure.
8. Complete FAI documentation and attach machine logs and maintenance confirmations.

Sign-off
1. Inspector name: ____________________
2. Inspector signature: ____________________
3. Date: ____________________
4. QA reviewer name: ____________________
5. QA reviewer signature: ____________________
